care.formulaArchetype: Leave-on 30 ml niacinamide and betaine facial serum with glycerin, sodium hyaluronate, arginine, a phenoxyethanol-based preservative system and fragrance.
care.advisoryBoundary: Supports a lightweight hydrating and radiance-focused cosmetic routine. It does not diagnose or treat acne, hyperpigmentation, rosacea, dermatitis or another condition. Shake well; apply a few drops to clean, dry skin morning or evening and massage until absorbed. Fragrance and leave-on ingredients may not suit every reactive skin: patch test, stop if burning, stinging or rash develops, and seek clinical advice for persistent, painful, spreading, infected or rapidly changing symptoms.
